sheets/holmes: STYLE: cinematic space-opera concept art in a painterly hard-surface hybrid — solid 3D-like forms with visible hand-painted brush texture on every surface, strong rim light cutting silhouettes against a light source, oil-paint edges, deep shadows, no photoreal rendering, no flat cel-shading. Composition: diagonals, off-centre subject on rule-of-thirds points, a large curve (planet rim or orbital ring) leaving the frame. Series palette: indigo-violet sky #2b2a5e and blue-white #cfe3ff with gold accents #d9b56a; the company (Baker Corporation) is always gold thin lines on black glass. CHARACTER DESIGN SHEET layout on a dark charcoal board: large painted bust top-left; full-body turnaround FRONT / SIDE / BACK in the centre; a row of six small expression studies (thinking, skeptical, determined, curious, amused, cold); three key items at the bottom-left; six colour swatches bottom-right; only tiny sparse label text. Subject: SHERLOCK HOLMES of the Baker Corporation: mid-30s, lean, sharp-featured, dark unruly hair, long charcoal coat with a high collar, gloved hands, a gold Baker Corporation pin, eyes that are already three steps ahead.
